quote: reduces severity of symptoms associated with the common cold and throat, nasal, bronchial irritations: cough, headache, hoarseness, sore throat
note: The homeopathic labels relieve the symptom 'sore throat' (and throat irritation) as part of cold/sinus symptom relief; no label names pharyngitis as a disease treated, so the edge swaps a symptom for the disease.

quote: indicated for the nutritional support of infants (including those of low birth weight) and young pediatric patients requiring TPN
note: The amino-acid solutions provide parenteral nutritional support; low-birth-weight infants are the population and 'small for gestational age' itself appears only in a warning about lipid clearance, never as a condition treated.

quote: Treatment of hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (hATTR amyloidosis) in adult patients with stage 1 or stage 2 polyneuropathy.
note: The thing treated is hATTR amyloidosis; polyneuropathy is the 'in patients with' stage qualifier defining the population, not the named target.

quote: In patients with concomitant HIV infection, the physician should be aware of current recommendation of CDC. It is possible these patients may require a longer course of treatment
note: Pyrazinamide is indicated for active tuberculosis; HIV infection is mentioned only as a concomitant condition affecting TB treatment duration.

quote: PHOTOFRIN is indicated for the palliation of patients with completely obstructing esophageal cancer, or of patients with partially obstructing esophageal cancer
note: Palliative management of esophageal cancer is a named indication, which counts as management of the disease.

quote: CIPRO HC OTIC is indicated for the treatment of acute otitis externa in adult and pediatric patients, one year and older, due to susceptible strains of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
note: Acute otitis externa is named directly as the infection treated; the otic products pair ciprofloxacin (the antibacterial) with a steroid, so the anti-infective indication is attributable to ciprofloxacin.

quote: de novo and secondary MDS of all French-American-British subtypes (refractory anemia, refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts, refractory anemia with excess blasts
note: MDS with ring sideroblasts is the WHO name for the FAB subtype 'refractory anemia with ringed sideroblasts', which is explicitly listed among indicated MDS subtypes.

quote: Clobazam tablets are indicated for the adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age or older.
note: Adjunctive treatment of the seizures of LGS is management of the named syndrome, analogous to the rubric's pain-of-osteoarthritis example.

quote: May also be useful as adjunctive therapy in the treatment of duodenal ulcer.
note: Duodenal ulcer is named as an adjunctive-therapy indication (with a hedge that healing benefit is unproven, not an explicit non-indication); the anticholinergic/antispasmodic effect is atropine's own.

quote: SYNAREL is indicated for treatment of central precocious puberty (CPP) (gonadotropin-dependent precocious puberty) in children of both sexes.
note: Central precocious puberty is named verbatim as the condition treated.

quote: PARSABIV is indicated for the treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (HPT) in adult patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) on hemodialysis.
note: Secondary hyperparathyroidism is the target; CKD on hemodialysis is the population in which it is treated.

quote: Hematologic Disorders Acquired (autoimmune) hemolytic anemia, Diamond-Blackfan anemia, pure red cell aplasia, selected cases of secondary thrombocytopenia.
note: Pure red cell aplasia is listed by name among the hematologic disorders for which the injectable betamethasone is indicated.

quote: Actinomycosis (cervicofacial disease and thoracic and abdominal disease) Actinomyces Israelil
note: Actinomycosis is a named clinical indication in the penicillin G indication/organism table.

quote: indicated in adults for the treatment of community-acquired pneumonia (moderate severity only) caused by beta-lactamase producing isolates of Haemophilus influenzae
note: Only combination (piperacillin/tazobactam) labels are present, but piperacillin is the antibacterial component and tazobactam only a beta-lactamase inhibitor, so the CAP indication is attributable to piperacillin.

quote: Ergotamine tartrate and caffeine tablets are indicated as therapy to abort or prevent vascular headache; e.g., migraine, migraine variants
note: Migraine is named as the indication on the ergotamine/caffeine labels and additional non-combination entries state 'treats migraine', so the text supports the edge; caffeine's adjuvant role in the combination is a possible counter-reading.

quote: treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver, and renal disease, including the nephrotic syndrome
note: Nephrotic syndrome is named and its edema is managed by furosemide, which the rubric treats as management of the named disease (like pain of osteoarthritis).

quote: Rebif is indicated for the treatment of: patients with a single demyelinating event with an active inflammatory process
note: The EMA text indicates treatment of a single demyelinating event (CIS) and relapsing multiple sclerosis, both demyelinating diseases, so 'demyelinating disease' is a near parent that still describes what is indicated.

quote: adjunctive therapy of refractory generalized tonic-clonic seizures in patients with severe myoclonic epilepsy in infancy (SMEI, Dravet's syndrome)
note: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure is the current ILAE term for generalized tonic-clonic seizure, which is the named target of adjunctive therapy.

quote: AVYCAZ is a combination of ceftazidime, a cephalosporin, and avibactam, a beta-lactamase inhibitor, indicated for the treatment of the following infections
note: cIAI is indicated only on combination labels (ceftazidime/avibactam, aztreonam/avibactam) where the antibacterial activity belongs to the partner beta-lactam and avibactam is the enzyme-inhibitor adjunct, so the indication cannot be attributed to avibactam alone.

quote: ZEVTERA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream infection (bacteremia) (SAB), including those with right-sided infective endocarditis
note: Right-sided S. aureus infective endocarditis is a subtype of bacterial endocarditis and is explicitly included within the treated SAB indication, though the 'including those with' phrasing could be read as population.

quote: Moderate to severe osteoarthritis
note: Osteoarthritis is listed by name among the indications for indomethacin capsules and suppositories.

quote: KALYDECO is indicated for the treatment of cystic fibrosis (CF) in patients aged 1 month and older who have at least one mutation in the CFTR gene that is responsive to ivacaftor
note: Cystic fibrosis is named verbatim as the disease treated on single-ingredient ivacaftor labels and EMA text.

quote: Paroxetine Tablets are indicated for the treatment of social anxiety disorder, also known as social phobia, as defined in DSM-IV (300.23).
note: Social phobia is named as an exact synonym of the indicated social anxiety disorder.

quote: Vigabatrin tablets are indicated as adjunctive therapy for adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with refractory complex partial seizures
note: Refractory complex partial seizures are the indicated condition; complex partial epilepsy is the same disorder, and 'not a first line agent' is a restriction, not a negation.

quote: The parenteral route is indicated when oral administration is not feasible as in anorexia, nausea and vomiting, and preoperative and postoperative conditions.
note: The only 'anorexia' mention is the symptom (loss of appetite) as a circumstance justifying parenteral pyridoxine; the deficiency is what is treated and anorexia nervosa is never named.

quote: Phendimetrazine tartrate tablets are indicated in the management of exogenous obesity as a short term adjunct (a few weeks) in a regimen of weight reduction
note: Exogenous obesity is named verbatim as the condition managed.

quote: Avastin, in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel, followed by Avastin as a single agent, is indicated for the treatment of patients with stage III or IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
note: Epithelial ovarian cancer is ovarian carcinoma and is a named indication in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: They are also indicated in chronic anterior uveitis and corneal injury from chemical, radiation or thermal burns
note: Chronic anterior uveitis is named directly, and iritis/iridocyclitis (synonyms for anterior uveitis) are listed among ophthalmic indications.

quote: Buprenorphine Sublingual Tablets are indicated for the treatment of opioid dependence and are preferred for induction.
note: Opioid dependence (opiate dependence) is the named indication on single-ingredient buprenorphine labels and EMA text.
The supplied multivitamin/iron labels address vitamin supplementation, caries prophylaxis and iron/folate deficiency anemia; marasmus or protein-energy malnutrition is never mentioned.

quote: treatment of adult patients with unresectable, well or moderately differentiated, locally advanced or metastatic gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs)
note: Well or moderately differentiated GEP-NETs are grade 1/2 digestive-system neuroendocrine tumors, matching the edge at the same granularity.

quote: Heart failure Jardiance is indicated in adults for the treatment of symptomatic chronic heart failure.
note: Symptomatic chronic heart failure is named as a treated condition in the EMA text, which covers congestive heart failure.

quote: EPKINLY is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory FL after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
note: Relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma is a named indication in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Dapagliflozin, when used as a component of dapagliflozin and metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets, is indicated in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus to reduce the risk of:
note: Heart-failure outcomes appear only on SGLT2-inhibitor/metformin combination labels and are explicitly attributed to the dapagliflozin or empagliflozin component; metformin's own indication is glycemic control and heart failure otherwise appears only in warnings.

quote: Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.
note: Nebivolol is indicated only for hypertension; myocardial infarction appears as class-wide background on blood-pressure benefit, with the label adding that no controlled trials demonstrate risk reduction with nebivolol, and otherwise only in warnings.

quote: ACTEMRA (tocilizumab) is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis who have had an inadequate response to one or more Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs
note: Rheumatoid arthritis is named verbatim as a treated condition in FDA and EMA text.

quote: DIURIL is indicated as adjunctive therapy in edema associated with congestive heart failure, hepatic cirrhosis, and corticosteroid and estrogen therapy.
note: Hepatic cirrhosis is named and its edema is managed adjunctively by chlorothiazide, which the rubric treats as management of the named disease rather than a symptom swap.

quote: Useful in the management of pruritus due to allergic conditions such as chronic urticaria and atopic and contact dermatoses, and in histamine-mediated pruritus.
note: Atopic dermatosis is atopic eczema and is named as a condition whose pruritus hydroxyzine manages, analogous to the rubric's pain-of-osteoarthritis TARGET example.
